does_not_change: the frozen candidate workstreams (WS-09 / WS-10 / WS-11 / WS-12 / WS-13)

amendment_scope.existing_r3_harness_and_tests: UNCHANGED / NOT AUTHORIZED TO MODIFY IN THIS CHECKPOINT

accepted_state_reference.note: this block is a read-only reference to the accepted state; this amendment consumes it and recomputes nothing from it. In particular the accepted R3 full tie at P3 is a freeze, not a ranking.

priority_comparator_operationalization.APPLIES_TO: the future governed R4 priority decision; no priority ranking, no top workstream, no recommended next workstream and no recommendation support is computed in this checkpoint

GLOBAL_LEXICOGRAPHIC_ALGORITHM.PROCESSING: process the criteria in the frozen sequence; each criterion consumes the survivor set produced by the previous criterion
GLOBAL_LEXICOGRAPHIC_ALGORITHM.EVALUATED: a mechanical comparator distinguishes at least one survivor; retain only the best-valued survivors (all survivors that share the winning value)
GLOBAL_LEXICOGRAPHIC_ALGORITHM.TIED: all mechanically comparable survivors share an equal value; continue to the next criterion
GLOBAL_LEXICOGRAPHIC_ALGORITHM.UNIQUE_LEADER_RULE: if the survivor count is exactly 1, UNIQUE_LEADER = that workstream and the remaining P criteria are not evaluated
GLOBAL_LEXICOGRAPHIC_ALGORITHM.EVIDENCE_TRACE_REQUIREMENT: every per-workstream value and every elimination must carry a mechanical, frozen-evidence traceable basis; a value without a trace is NOT_ESTABLISHED and a criterion resting on it is NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED

NO_HIGHER_CRITERION_MAY_BE_SKIPPED.RULE: if any Pn is NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED or CONFLICT, the criteria P(n+1)..P7 may never be used to manufacture a leader
NO_HIGHER_CRITERION_MAY_BE_SKIPPED.COROLLARY: a lower criterion cannot resolve an unresolved higher-priority criterion
NO_HIGHER_CRITERION_MAY_BE_SKIPPED.FORBIDDEN_TRANSFORMATION: no later conversion into percentage weights such as quality impact / effort / risk percentages

P1_PARENT_GOVERNANCE_ELIGIBILITY.CRITERION_QUESTION: is the current candidate workstream still a governance-admissible candidate?
ELIGIBLE_REQUIRES_ALL_OF: the workstream is inside the frozen candidate set
no parent evidence disproves the workstream as a whole

BLOCKED_SPECIFIC_PATH_SCOPE_RULE.a specific causal or remediation path be: does not automatically make the whole workstream INELIGIBLE
BLOCKED_SPECIFIC_PATH_SCOPE_RULE.INELIGIBLE_REQUIRES: parent evidence that explicitly blocks every lawful next action of that workstream

STATUS_RULES.EVALUATED: at least one survivor is INELIGIBLE (or at least one is ELIGIBLE while another is INELIGIBLE)
STATUS_RULES.TIED: all survivors share the same P1 value
STATUS_RULES.NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED: a survivor's PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER or whole-workstream disproval status is not mechanically derivable from frozen evidence

FORBIDDEN: treating a blocked specific path as whole-workstream ineligibility
introducing any new governance blocker not carried by frozen parent evidence
EVIDENCE_TRACE_REQUIRED: freeze status of the candidate set
PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER value and its parent evidence location

P2_DEPENDENCY_PRECEDENCE.GRAPH_SOURCE: the already accepted action-scoped dependency graph (Amendment 005 semantics)
P2_DEPENDENCY_PRECEDENCE.EDGE_APPLICABILITY_REQUIREMENT: an edge may be used only when its APPLIES_TO_ACTION covers the compared workstreams' current NEXT_PERMISSIBLE_ACTION, or is ALL_ACTIONS

DIRECTION_SEMANTICS.FROM=A, TO=B, EDGE_TYPE=BLOCKED_BY: A is blocked by B, therefore B precedes A

ACTION_SCOPE_DISCIPLINE.EDGE_WITHOUT_ESTABLISHED_ACTION_SCOPE: blocks no action and establishes no hard precedence

MECHANICAL_RULE.acyclic applicable hard precedence exist: retain the workstreams that are not deferred by another surviving workstream (eliminate every survivor that has an applicable hard-precedence predecessor inside the survivor set)

P2_DEPENDENCY_PRECEDENCE.COMPARATOR: deferred survivor is eliminated; non-deferred survivor is retained

STATUS_RULES.EVALUATED: at least one survivor is eliminated by applicable hard precedence
STATUS_RULES.CONFLICT: a cycle or contradictory hard precedence

FORBIDDEN: using CAN_PRECEDE / INDEPENDENT / NOT_ESTABLISHED to eliminate a survivor
using a SEPARATE_EXECUTION scoped edge for FRESH_ATTRIBUTION
inferring an edge that the accepted action-scoped graph does not carry
re-resolving edge action scope in this or any later checkpoint
EVIDENCE_TRACE_REQUIRED: the accepted action-scoped dependency graph digest

P3_READINESS.CONSUMES_ONLY: the already accepted READINESS_CLASS per workstream
P3_READINESS.COMPARATOR: retain only the survivors holding the highest readiness class among the input survivors

STATUS_RULES.EVALUATED: the survivor readiness classes are not all equal
STATUS_RULES.TIED: all survivor readiness classes are equal
STATUS_RULES.NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED: a survivor readiness class is missing or not single-valued

P3_READINESS.NOTE: this amendment freezes the comparator only; it does not and may not derive any actual P3 survivor set

P4_DIRECT_LINKAGE_TO_CURRENTLY_FAILING_Q.YES_IFF: the workstream carries at least one link with LINK_TYPE = DIRECT_LINK whose FAILING_GATE is inside the currently failing-gate set and which carries a lawful evidence trace

STATUS_RULES.EVALUATED: at least one survivor has HAS_DIRECT_LINK = NO (or values differ across survivors)
STATUS_RULES.NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED: a survivor's direct-link status is not mechanically derivable from frozen evidence

FORBIDDEN: CASE_EXACT direct link > FACT_RECALL direct link
CITATION_COVERAGE direct link > other direct links
a link without an evidence trace
P4_DIRECT_LINKAGE_TO_CURRENTLY_FAILING_Q.MULTIPLE_YES_OUTCOME: P4 = TIED; do not count links

P5_NARROW_MECHANICALLY_DEFINABLE_TARGET_.COMPARED_SURFACE: the purpose-scoped target of the CURRENT NEXT PERMISSIBLE ACTION of each survivor

FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SOURCE_RULE.FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE =: and the accepted R3 derivation explicitly adopts the stable DOMAIN_ELIGIBLE_CASE_IDS as the fresh-attribution target -> CURRENT_ACTION_TARGET_CASE_IDS = DOMAIN_ELIGIBLE_CASE_IDS
FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SOURCE_RULE.status: this is the lawful target-set source of the current R3

OTHER_ACTION_TARGET_SOURCE_RULE.comparable_only_when: an explicit mechanically traceable case-ID target exists

P5_NARROW_MECHANICALLY_DEFINABLE_TARGET_.COMPARATOR: lower positive integer wins (smaller positive target-case count = NARROWER = better at P5)
P5_NARROW_MECHANICALLY_DEFINABLE_TARGET_.SCOPE: applies when all surviving workstreams share CURRENT_ACTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE = YES and a common target unit (case IDs)

STATUS_RULES.EVALUATED: comparable target-case counts distinguish at least one survivor
STATUS_RULES.TIED: all comparable target-case counts are equal
STATUS_RULES.NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED: the target units do not agree, or target IDs cannot be mechanically formed, or at least one survivor target cardinality is NOT_ESTABLISHED

P5_NARROW_MECHANICALLY_DEFINABLE_TARGET_.HALT_RULE: NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED -> STOP; never proceed to P6

P6_LATEST_STATE_EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS.CONSUMES_ONLY: the LATEST_ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS mechanically derived by the accepted workstream matrix
P6_LATEST_STATE_EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS.CURRENT_MEANING: current-state compatible workstream evidence already exists
P6_LATEST_STATE_EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS.NOT_ESTABLISHED_RULE: NOT_ESTABLISHED is never automatically upgraded to HISTORICAL_STALE
P6_LATEST_STATE_EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS.PRODUCTION_HASH_RULE: a production hash difference alone still does not constitute freshness
P6_LATEST_STATE_EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS.COMPARATOR: retain only the survivors at the best (earliest) ordinal position among the input survivors

STATUS_RULES.EVALUATED: the survivor freshness ordinals are not all equal
STATUS_RULES.TIED: all survivor freshness ordinals are equal
STATUS_RULES.NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED: a survivor cannot obtain a single-valued traceable LATEST_ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS

P7_LOWER_CROSS_SUBSYSTEM_CONFOUND.MEANING: single primary subsystem mechanically identifiable -> lower cross-subsystem confound

STATUS_RULES.EVALUATED: at least one survivor has SCOPE_ISOLATABLE = NO (or values differ)
STATUS_RULES.TIED: SCOPE_ISOLATABLE is identical across all survivors

FORBIDDEN: penalizing Product + Measurement coexistence by itself
manual judgement that one subsystem is cleaner

FINAL_TIE.basis: the frozen tie outcome of priority_decision_rules.tie_outcome

HALT_MECHANICS.TRIGGER: the first higher criterion Pn whose COMPARATOR_STATUS is NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED
HALT_MECHANICS.EXCEPTION: only when the section-16 special outcome is strictly satisfied
HALT_MECHANICS.CONFLICT_BEHAVIOR: COMPARATOR_STATUS = CONFLICT also stops the ranking immediately

PRECONDITIONS_ALL_OF: no unique workstream leader has been mechanically established
all surviving workstreams have READINESS_CLASS = R3
all surviving workstreams have NEXT_PERMISSIBLE_ACTION = FRESH_ATTRIBUTION
no applicable hard dependency resolves their ordering
the first unresolved / non-operationalized distinction requires comparative current-state attribution across multiple surviving workstreams before a unique workstream can be mechanically selected
FRESH_CROSS_WORKSTREAM_ATTRIBUTION_ONLY.PROOF_OBLIGATION: the artifact must mechanically demonstrate that the missing comparative fresh attribution is precisely what prevents a unique leader

ANTI_ABUSE.conditional_downgrade_path: a not-mechanically-operationalized or conflicting criterion may only fall back to NOT_ESTABLISHED unless the proof obligation is strictly satisfied

FRESH_CROSS_WORKSTREAM_ATTRIBUTION_ONLY.RECOMMENDATION_SUPPORT_BASIS: there is no unique workstream leader

RECOMMENDATION_SUPPORT_RULES_UNCHANGED.EVALUATION_GATE: workstream recommendation support is evaluated only after a unique workstream leader has been mechanically established

NO_ACTUAL_PRIORITY_DECISION_IN_THIS_CHEC.CONSTRAINT: this checkpoint freezes comparators only; it computes no survivor set, no winner and no recommendation

effective_analysis_design_definition.payload_construction: payload = {key: parent_preflight[key] for key in parent_preflight.analysis_design_digest_spec.extracted_keys}; payload['case_classification_schema'] = amendment_001.amended_case_state_schema; payload['effective_analysis_design_additions'] = amendment_001.effective_analysis_design_additions; payload['workstream_axis_mapping'] = amendment_002.workstream_axis_mapping; payload['workstream_bucket_projection'] = amendment_003.workstream_bucket_projection; payload['workstream_bucket_projection']['DOMAIN_ELIGIBILITY_BEFORE_PROJECTION'] = amendment_004.workstream_domain_eligibility; payload['readiness_resolution_and_action_scoped_dependency'] = amendment_005.readiness_resolution_and_action_scoped_dependency; payload['priority_comparator_operationalization'] = amendment_006.priority_comparator_operationalization; digest = sha256(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8'))
effective_analysis_design_definition.parent_effective_digest_computable_from_: YES (the construction is cumulative and each parent amendment contributes exactly the key it declares; removing the last added key reproduces the parent digest)

integrity.PRE_CHANGE_WORKSPACE_MANIFEST_RULE: all regular files; exclude path segments {.git, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache}; exclude suffixes {.pyc, .pyo}; per-file hash = sha256-path-content-v2-canonical-lf (CRLF/CR normalized to LF for text suffixes, raw bytes otherwise); digest = sha256 over sorted '<relpath>\0<filehash>' entries joined by LF, UTF-8
integrity.AMENDMENT_FINALIZATION: the amendment is created on the single authorized path; the two effective-design digest fields are then recomputed from this very artifact and finalized in place on the same single authorized path; no other path is written at any time and no temporary or scratch file is created

authorization_boundary.PUBLISH_WORKSPACE: READ-ONLY / NO SYNC / NO WRITE / NO GIT MUTATION
